I saved this as a project convention in EngramDB, so other sessions and collaborators will see it when they query the project's memory:

> All timestamps in the database are stored in UTC. They're converted to the customer's timezone only in the API layer.

I also added one point you didn't state: the API layer should convert customer input back to UTC before it's stored. Tell me if that's wrong and I'll remove it.

Nothing about timezones was already recorded, so there was nothing to replace or contradict. The memory ID is `01a0f9fa-c852-7b50-b4c0-2d1a8c450dfd`.
